newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium sells Donnay to Britain's Sport and Ski.
newsitem.headline: Belgium sells Donnay to Britain's Sport and Ski.

text.p: The regional government of Belgium's southern province of Wallonia said on Thursday it had decided to sell tennis equipment manufacturer Donnay International to Britain's Sport & Ski.
"The offer of Sport & Ski was the best financially and industrially," Walloon Premier Robert Collignon told reporters.
Under the plan the British firm will pay the Walloon government 125 million francs for 99.1 percent of Donnay.
Sport & Ski, which specialises in selling sports goods through a chain of 40 shops, was set up in 1982. It had a net profit of 200 million francs last year.
The firm, which employs between 550 and 800 people depending on the season, has promised to retain Donnay's former factory at Couvin and turn it into a distribution centre.
